title: AgentConnections
description: The registry of agent connections in the per-user state directory, <state>/agents.yaml (ADR-0030, ADR-0037). Each MCP client connection (for example one agent of a multi-agent system) is registered on its own with a name, which becomes its author agent:<name>, and the disclosure target class it represents. The token itself is never stored, only its SHA-256. Names are unique (cross-check `agent-names`). Local state: never sent, exported or shared.

name.description: The agent name; the connection acts as agent:<name>.

target.description: What the agent's answers may reach: local_model only if every model the agent uses runs under the user's control; otherwise cloud_model (ADR-0012, ADR-0037).

tokenHash.description: sha256:<hex> of the bearer token; the token is shown once at registration and never stored.

revokedAt.description: Set when the connection was removed; a revoked token is rejected.
